description: List the developer's own capabilities with their status (draft / live / suspended) and slug. Use it before publishing to see what already exists, and after to check what went live. Needs the developer's qumge key. (Older clients may still call this tool as list_apps.)

qumge_key.description: Optional: your Qumge API key, for clients that cannot set an Authorization header. Takes precedence over the header. Never echoed back.

name: list_caps
